- (akr 0.3.3 revise --state) akr revise --state completed on raw-autotune.work.train-camsdd-scene-classifier failed with AKR-L002 claiming 3 revisions are unsuperseded although states were consistent (1-3 superseded, head proposed/active). Root cause: revisions 2 and 3 had been written without supersedes back-edges, so edge-based head resolution goes ambiguous the moment every revision is state-terminal. The failure only surfaces on the transition to a terminal state, and the message points at revision count rather than the missing edges, which cost a debugging detour. Fix that worked: give the new head supersedes [ @key/1, @key/2, @key/3 ]. A friendlier diagnostic would name the edge-less revisions.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.state-only-revise-on-sealed-work-head-l002/2`
